title: Graduation Capstone Project: The Stolen Recipe (《失竊的祕方》)
award: Multiple National Competition Awards (全國競賽多獎)
team: Tu Cheng-en (涂承恩), Li Guan-lin (李冠霖), Zhang Shu-ying (張淑盈), Tang Li-rong (唐莉蓉)
achievements: 2025 Youth Innovative Design Festival — Digital Multimedia and Game Design Category / Creative Digital Video Group: Excellence Award (2025 青春設計節 — 數位多媒體與遊戲設計類／創意數位影片組 優選) [CHECK]

2025 National Practical Project Competition for Technical Colleges and Universities — Animation and Interactive Multimedia Category: Shortlisted (stood out from 1,181 works) (2025 全國技專校院實務專題製作競賽 — 動漫互動多媒體類別 入圍)
The 21st Computer Animation Competition for Technical Colleges and Universities — Direct Entry Category: Merit Award (第 21 屆技專校院電腦動畫競賽 — 直接參賽組 佳作) [CHECK]
content:
The 2D animated short The Stolen Recipe (《失竊的祕方》) was co-created by Tu Cheng-en (涂承恩), Li Guan-lin (李冠霖), Zhang Shu-ying (張淑盈), and Tang Li-rong (唐莉蓉), with 陳美蓉 as faculty advisor.

The story takes 'misunderstanding and reconciliation' as its theme, depicting an old chef who misunderstands a new restaurant owner due to the theft of a secret recipe book. Through character design and visual narrative contrast, it prompts audiences to reflect on judging people by appearances, while integrating core SDG values of Gender Equality, Reduced Inequalities, and Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions.

title: Bahamut ACG Creation Contest · Double Excellence Awards (巴哈姆特 ACG 創作大賽 · 優選雙獎) [CHECK]
team: Android (《人造人》): Bo Hao-yuan (博浩原), Rong Xuan-yi (戎軒頤), Chen Zheng-ming (陳政名), Li Yu-xian (李育賢); Obsessive Reality (《癡迷的現實》): Song Qiu-yang (宋秋陽), Chen Zhi-yang (陳志揚), Teng-chuan Li-xing (藤川黎星)
achievements: Bahamut ACG Creation Contest · Excellence Award × 2 (stood out among 69 shortlisted entries across Taiwan) (巴哈姆特 ACG 創作大賽 · 優選賞) [CHECK]
Android (《人造人》) — Echoing SDG 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
Obsessive Reality (《癡迷的現實》) — 1980s nostalgic style, integrating SDG 4 and SDG 12
content:
The 2025 ACG Creation Contest was organized by Taiwan's largest ACG community platform, Gamer / Bahamut (巴哈姆特電玩資訊站). Two original animated works from the AGD Department, Android (《人造人》) and Obsessive Reality (《癡迷的現實》), simultaneously won the Excellence Award, standing out among 69 shortlisted works across Taiwan.

Android (《人造人》) takes artificially created intelligent life as its theme, echoing SDG 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions.
Obsessive Reality (《癡迷的現實》) presents the conflict between idol worship and rational cognition in a 1980s nostalgic art style, incorporating SDG 4: Quality Education and SDG 12: Responsible Consumption and Production.

title: International Times Young Creative Awards · 2nd Place (時報金犢獎國際競賽 · 第二名)
team: Pei Xin-hui (裴欣慧), Huang Ruo-ting (黃若庭), Wang Qiao-an (王巧安), Cai Si-qi (蔡思淇)
achievements: The 34th International Times Young Creative Awards · Yung-Ching Realty Recruitment Advertising Category: 2nd Place (第 34 屆時報金犢獎國際競賽 · 永慶房屋招募廣告類 第二名) [CHECK]
Stood out among over 10,000 entries worldwide
The department received 18 finalist nominations in total (Zhang Chun-ya (張純雅) 11 groups + Chen Mei-jung (陳美蓉) 7 groups)
content:
In the 34th International Times Young Creative Awards (第 34 屆時報金犢獎國際競賽), the Yung-Ching Realty Employer Brand Recruitment Advertising Campaign Series (Shiba Inu Edition, Raccoon Edition, Squirrel Edition) won 2nd Place in the 'Yung-Ching Realty Recruitment Advertising Category', standing out among over 10,000 entries worldwide.

Using animal character designs, it translated three major recruitment appeals—'no binding contract', 'no burnout overtime', and 'no pay deductions'—into a lighthearted and humorous visual language.

title: Professor Su Zhong-he (蘇中和) · World's Top 2% Scientists
award: Listed for 4 Consecutive Years (連四年榮登)
achievements: Selected for four consecutive years in the World's Top 2% Scientists (《全球前 2% 頂尖科學家》)
A representative paper has amassed thousands of citations
Ranked within the world's top 2% in the field of education research
content:
Professor Su Zhong-he (蘇中和) (Vice President and Dean of the College of Design) has been selected for four consecutive years in the World's Top 2% Scientists (《全球前 2% 頂尖科學家》), with a representative paper cited thousands of times, ranking among the world's top 2% in the field of education research.

His research scope encompasses design education, gamified STEM education, digital twins, and augmented reality design, while successfully expanding into intelligent design and AI image processing.
